# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.description }}

This is {{ site.author.name }}'s personal site: a short bio, career history, and occasional writing. Sushant founded Biclay (https://biclay.com) and is building CiteOnly (https://citeonly.com), a question-answering system that only returns passages from the user's own documents, with sources.

## Pages

- [Home]({{ site.url }}/): Photo and short bio.
- [Career]({{ site.url }}/career/): Roles, projects, and education, most recent first.
- [Writing]({{ site.url }}/writing/): Notes and posts, filterable by tag.
